snippet.title: Game Settings - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3907260?utm_source=you-tube&utm_campaign=trailer

A journalist receives a mysterious package: a console, and a game. By tweaking cryptic parameters, you shape the environment and trigger strange events. But what are you really configuring? As the mystery unfolds, you begin to wonder who’s really in control.
